Sentence (English): Used three dishwashers before and after.
Comments (English): Used three dishwashers before and after. Talk about your feelings 1. The packaging is the most complete online shopping appliance I have ever purchased. The outer layer is completely heat-sealed with plastic film. The interior bubble wrap is intact and secured with wooden strips. Removable adhesive tape can be fixed in multiple places, as is done by major manufacturers. 2. The noise can only be said to be in line with expectations, almost the same as another imported machine. At first, I thought that the direct-drive inverter dishwasher would be very quiet, but most of the sound was still the sound of water flowing. 3. The function addition and subtraction time can be adjusted in multiple gears, and several programs can be set to meet daily use. Very practical 4. The first regret or shortcoming is that it is indeed too small. There is no room for larger tableware. It is probably the most difficult to install a tabletop dishwasher of the same type. The second is the design of the flip-up door. When the door is opened, water droplets from the door will drip onto the countertop. Because of the sealing ring, the door is indeed not so smooth to close. But other imported brands are not like this. I think Haier's other series of dishwashers are not like this; the salt hole is too awkward and it is difficult to add salt. In the past, Haier also came with a funnel for adding salt, but now it allows you to roll up a quick instruction paper instead of the funnel. We still see a lot of cost reductions, such as the metal filter plate at the base, which is very thin. The water inlet and outlet pipes are also thinner and cheaper than imported machines. Overall, it is worth buying. The product has exquisite workmanship, small overall size, and is easy to install and use. Haier's service is also good.
Comments (Original): 前后用过三个洗碗机。谈谈感受1. 包装 是我买过包装最完整的网购家电。外层完全用塑膜热封了。内部泡沫包装完好，带有木条固定。可移胶纸多处固定，大厂做法。2. 噪音 只能说符合预期吧，和另一个原装进口机差不多。起初还以为直驱变频洗碗机会很小声，不过声音多数还是水流搅动的声音。3. 功能 加减时间是可以多挡调节的，设置的几个程序也满足日常用途。很实用4. 遗憾或不足 首先就是的确太小了。大点的餐具放不下。同类型的台式洗碗机，估计它最不能装；其次就是上翻门的设计，开门时，门边的水珠会滴到台面上；因为有密封圈的原因，的确关门没有那么丝滑。但是别的进口品牌不是这样。我想海尔其它系列的洗碗机也不会这样吧；加盐孔太别扭了，加盐困难。以前海尔还附有一个加盐漏斗，现在改成让你用快速说明纸卷起来替代漏斗；还是看到不少降成本的地方，比如底座的金属滤板，很薄很薄。进水管和出水管与进口机相比也单薄和廉价一些。总的说来，值得购买，产品做工精致，整体尺寸小巧，安装使用简便。海尔的服务也不错。

Removable adhesive tape can be fixed in multiple places, as is done by major manufacturers. 2. The noise can only be said to be in line with expectations, almost the same as another imported machine. At first, I thought that the direct-drive inverter dishwasher would be very quiet, but most of the sound was still the sound of water flowing. 3. The function addition and subtraction time can be adjusted in multiple gears, and several programs can be set to meet daily use. Very practical 4. The first regret or shortcoming is that it is indeed too small. There is no room for larger tableware. It is probably the most difficult to install a tabletop dishwasher of the same type. The second is the design of the flip-up door. When the door is opened, water droplets from the door will drip onto the countertop. Because of the sealing ring, the door is indeed not so smooth to close. But other imported brands are not like this. I think Haier's other series of dishwashers are not like this; the salt hole is too awkward and it is difficult to add salt. In the past, Haier also came with a funnel for adding salt, but now it allows you to roll up a quick instruction paper instead of the funnel. We still see a lot of cost reductions, such as the metal filter plate at the base, which is very thin. The water inlet and outlet pipes are also thinner and cheaper than imported machines. Overall, it is worth buying. The product has exquisite workmanship, small overall size, and is easy to install and use. Haier's service is also good.
Comments (Original): 前后用过三个洗碗机。谈谈感受1. 包装 是我买过包装最完整的网购家电。外层完全用塑膜热封了。内部泡沫包装完好，带有木条固定。可移胶纸多处固定，大厂做法。2. 噪音 只能说符合预期吧，和另一个原装进口机差不多。起初还以为直驱变频洗碗机会很小声，不过声音多数还是水流搅动的声音。3. 功能 加减时间是可以多挡调节的，设置的几个程序也满足日常用途。很实用4. 遗憾或不足 首先就是的确太小了。大点的餐具放不下。同类型的台式洗碗机，估计它最不能装；其次就是上翻门的设计，开门时，门边的水珠会滴到台面上；因为有密封圈的原因，的确关门没有那么丝滑。但是别的进口品牌不是这样。我想海尔其它系列的洗碗机也不会这样吧；加盐孔太别扭了，加盐困难。以前海尔还附有一个加盐漏斗，现在改成让你用快速说明纸卷起来替代漏斗；还是看到不少降成本的地方，比如底座的金属滤板，很薄很薄。进水管和出水管与进口机相比也单薄和廉价一些。总的说来，值得购买，产品做工精致，整体尺寸小巧，安装使用简便。海尔的服务也不错。

Sentence (English): Nice dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Nice: Be aware of new installation method ] || ---------------- || Nice dishwasher. Replaced a nearly new GE D/W that had a faulty switch I replaced twice, then gave up□□. The new Bosch is very quiet, cleans great, and the front controls are intuitive and easy to use. There is a 'time remaining' display which is handy. Please note: Installation has been modified on these new models (Costco included a separate installation kit that isn't required). The water and drain lines are both pre-installed on the D/W, so there is nothing to do on the D/W or within the D/W cabinet space. There is a fairly large valve on the end of the 5' braided water line. Extending from the valve is a proprietary, non-removeable, short, 6" supply line with a 3/8" female compression fitting. The valve requires a 3" hole in your sink base cabinet. Mine was 2-1/2" and I had to enlarge it to get the valve through. The instructions say the valve is heavy when filled with water, and should rest on the cabinet floor. So. with a very short, non-removeable 6" supply line, your under-sink shut-off valve needs to be within a couple inches of the cabinet floor. Mine wasn't. You will need to either modify your plumbing to get the shut-off near the cabinet floor, or buy an extra supply line with a 3/8" female compression fitting on one end and a 3/8" male compression fitting on the other end to complete the hookup. If you've got some plumbing know-how and the correct parts, installation is fairly easy.

If it weren't for the red light projected on the ground, you'd have no idea it was running save for the random movement of lightweight utensils maybe getting moved with the water spray. While the jury is out for durability given it's so new to us, everything seems to be of high quality (I'd hope so at this pricepoint), and install was a snap once you get the appropriate inlet adapter. Fingers crossed it lasts at least as long as our old 13-yo GE unit.

Sentence (English): We have been using our Bosch Benchmark dishwasher for over 5 weeks now.
Comments (English): [ Bosch Benchmark Dishwasher critique ] || ---------------- || We have been using our Bosch Benchmark dishwasher for over 5 weeks now. It is every bit as good as advertised. Pots and dishes come out clean EVERY time we unload the machine. ANND so much more dry and almost water spot free. The adjustible racks make fitting oversized pans (my wife bakes) easy too. Our previous diswasher was a GE model that was very quiet, but the Bosch easily tops the old dishwasher for sound suppression. If my wife programs it and shuts the door and I come in later, I have to open the door to see if it's running, because it is SOO SILENT. My only not 100% positive comment concerns the 2nd rack (the one that holds glassware. When it is fully loaded with glasses, coffee mugs and sundry other dishware that fits there, it feels a little "shaky", like it's going to slip it's tracks. Now I've checked the fasteners and everything is tight and fitting correctly, and it has never sliopped it's tracks, but somehow it does not feel as firm and substantial as the rest of the components do. If I had to purchase a 2nd dishwasher I would get another one of these!

Sentence (English): Hesitation only delays delivery and causes my wrists to suffer!
Comments (English): Hesitation only delays delivery and causes my wrists to suffer! My husband bought me the dishwasher I had been agonizing over for so long, treating it like an early birthday present. Because of the negative reviews, I was half worried and half excited right up until I used it after installation. Comments (English): Hesitation only delays delivery and causes my wrists to suffer! My husband bought me the dishwasher I had been agonizing over for so long, treating it like an early birthday present. Because of the negative reviews, I was half worried and half excited right up until I used it after installation. But as soon as I opened it up after using it, I was so satisfied that I wondered, "Is this for real?" It cleaned so well that the dishes were squeaky clean. The dishes are shining. Please be careful when handling dishes right after they finish washing, as they are hot. I had eaten one dinner, so I divided one bottle of Frog detergent into four parts and used only one. An acquaintance who had used it told me to only use half of the 12-place setting capacity. Since this is a 6-place setting model, I calculated it as half of that, but it worked perfectly clean even with just a quarter. If you have a lot of dishes, you can just add a little more. I rinsed them just enough to wash off the seasoning before putting them in. Since I had cooked bulgogi, there was a lot of grease, but they washed well. I highly, highly recommend this dishwasher!

Sentence (English): I needed a replacement dishwasher that would accept a custom wood panel and kick plate.
Comments (English): [ Quiet and great looking ] || ---------------- || I needed a replacement dishwasher that would accept a custom wood panel and kick plate. I've heard good things about Bosch and found a decent sale at ABT Electronics. I installed it myself including the panel and kickplate with no issues. It looks and runs great. Much quieter than my Blomberg that it replaced. I wasn't sure I'd like the silverware tray but that's been fine. Takes a little longer to load since you have to individually set up each spoon, fork and knife. The only downside is cookie sheets. The prongs on the lowest rack are arranged such that a cookie sheet doesn't fit well and can easily hit the rotating sprayer stalling it or knocking it off. There's one spot on the very end that will hold a sheet, but if you bake a lot and use multiple cookie sheets, you're probably forced to space them across a few loads. Overall great unit. I'd recommend. By the way, it's only been in operation for about two months.

The timeline from initial call, tech visit, parts order and installation will be over three months. Bosch offers alternate options if you want to go through an 'authorized' third party. We came to this realization well into the process so we're almost pot committed to stay with the factory tech. However, if you find yourself in this situation consider that option early. It wasn't much better though, the only two approved third-party businesses in my area had suspect reviews and they have to come out, do a concurrent assessment of the problem and order their own parts - so it cancels any progress you have made on the factory tech side. Looking forward to the "bot" answering this review, but bottom line is we are disappointed with the quality of Bosch and excessive timeline to fix your faulty products. Sentence (English): I had this dishwasher installed in Nov 2022.
Comments (English): I had this dishwasher installed in Nov 2022. First the good - This thing is QUITE. Incredibly quiet, so much so it's hard to tell when it's on. I've had several dishwashers all claiming to be super quiet, but this one is the quietest of the bunch. That's it for the good. The bad - This dishwasher uses a different type of wash mechanism for the bottom rack. Not the spinning wand like most, but a bar that moves front-to-back redirecting a stream of water that originates in the back, called the AquaBlast. This doesn't seem to have the high pressure that a traditional dishwasher has. Even when brand new, this wash action didn't clean well. Then it didn't clean at all. The linear wash bar stopped moving all together so none of the dishes on the bottom rack would get cleaned. Samsung sent a repair tech out under warranty, who said this is common. He ordered parts and overall took a month to 'fix' it. It cleaned OK once again for a month, but stopped again. The only items that get cleaned on the bottom rack are plates. Bowls do not. Nothing facing down gets cleaned at all. Not even a little bit. So we've been using mostly the 2nd and small 3rd rack. As I was getting ready to schedule another warranty call, the spinning wash arm above the 3rd (top-most) rack fell off after a cycle. I didn't even have any dishes on the 3rd rack, the wash bar just fell right off. So now only dishes on the 2nd rack get cleaned and I have more for the repair tech to fix. Even when fully functional, the super quiet operation doesn't offset the sub-par clean. And the amount of repairs needed in less than a year and a half are far worse than anything. I highly recommend NOT buying this dishwasher. It is junk.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher was fine for about three months, then it started to get an "LD" error (leak detected) and it would stop running.
Comments (English): [ Ge QC on these dishwashers is terrible. Bad parts! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher was fine for about three months, then it started to get an "LD" error (leak detected) and it would stop running. After doing this twice in a row, I saw the leak coming from the left side, underneath, toward the back. Turns out that the dry boost heater, part number WD05X25648, was dribbling condensation out, which eventually made it's way into the pan and activated the leak sensor. When I took the part out, it flexed where it leaked because it was only held together with one screw. There were tabs for three more screws, but I guess adding three screws was too expensive for my $1k+ dishwasher. What a QC nightmare. Call me GE - you should recall this part and fix it for everyone getting the LD error.

Sentence (English): Bought this to replace a top of line dishwasher by another manufacturer after several issues.
Comments (English): [ Great with few annoyances ] || ---------------- || Bought this to replace a top of line dishwasher by another manufacturer after several issues. Works great and dries great but a few things that bother me I dislike compared to my old machine. The cutlery basket is was too small. Not just how many it holds but the actually holes for silverware. Ours is chunky and do not physically fit. We had to physically cut many out to make our silverware fit. Yes there's a third shelf for silverware too but that's routinely full of toddler and baby stuff for us. No matter what pods I'm using the dishes reek of soap. It's especially noticeable with anything plastic and cups. The odors really bothers me on cups and alters the taste. Not sure if it's the dishwasher leaving soap residue or the mineral drying leaves a scent. Finally minor complaint I don't want to have to use an app to set delay. There needs to be a simple button, it's infuriating.

Sentence (English): Bravo BOSCH, YOU are the BEST!

We have had a number of dishwashers in my lifetime, but never have I purchased and installed a dishwasher of this incredible quality. After setting everything up and starting the wash cycle, I had walked away and when I returned, I could not hear the machine running. I walked up and put my hand on the door and could barely feel it running, but it was. At least in our installation the Bosch Series 800 Dishwasher is so quite you won't know it is there. As a matter of fact, you might even think it never ran a cycle. When you check your last load, I am sure you will find, as we have a number of times now, everything is Perfectly Clean. Sentence (English): Buyer Beware.
Comments (English): [ Warranty Limited even for manufacturing defects! ] || ---------------- || Buyer Beware. I had not purchased a Best Buy 5-year protection plan and now regret that decision! I purchased in in 9/2019 (4 1/2 years old) I recently had Bosch come to service the Dishwasher because the front stainless steel panel was rusting and that it was due to a manufacturing defect. Rusting is a slower process that will not show up in the first year of usage which is all their warranty covers. We have only been sponging it clean with soap and water, never any chemicals. They would not cover any portion of the $373.44 cost to replace it (appliance cost $764.95 originally! ). They are not a company who stands behind their products beyond what is technically covered in their warranty, even if it is a manufacturing (not usage-caused) defect.

Sentence (English): It's been about half a year since I started using it.
Comments (English): It's been about half a year since I started using it. I was thinking about going to another brand, but I couldn't give up on the unity and design because I ended up going to LG because I wanted to match my wedding dress with Objet. Home appliances are a big deal, so I was worried about buying a bigger one, but I'm a two-person household and the current structure of my house makes it impossible to install, so I bought a standing type and I'm satisfied with the result. I don't cook much, so there aren't many dishes to wash, so I collect this size and rotate it, so I think it's okay unless you cook a lot at home. What I was confused about at first was the detergent compartment, but my husband was there when I installed it, so I didn't hear a separate explanation, but it said 'detergent compartment', so I looked closely to see if I could put it in. Since the structure falls inside when the door is closed anyway, wouldn't it be better to drop it inside or have it written 'detergent compartment', but some people might use liquid type, so it's difficult^^,,,. Anyway, it is a little lacking when using a lot of large pans or plates, but it is more than enough for everyday use. And I am using a transparent glass cup as a water cup, and I am very satisfied with the fact that it can be cleaned cleanly without any water stains.
Comments (Original): 사용한 지 반 년쯤 됐습니다다른 브랜드로 갈까 했는데 혼수를 오브제로 싹 맞추게 돼서 통일성이랑 디자인 포기 못 하고 엘지로 왔어용가전은 거거익선이라고 이왕 사는 거 큰 걸로 살까 고민이 됐지만 2인 가구이기도 하고 현재 집 구조상 설치가 불가해서 스탠드형으로 구매했고 결과적으로는 만족합니다 음식을 많이 해먹지 않아서 설거지 거리가 많이 없기 때문에 이 사이즈도 모아서 돌리고 있어서 집에서 요리 많이 하시는 거 아니면 괜찮다고 생각해요 처음에 당황했던 건 세제 넣는 공간인데 설치할 때 남편이 있었어서 설명을 따로 못 들었는데 ‘세제투입구’라고 적혀있어서 넣는건가 항참을 살폈습니다 어차피 문 닫을 때 안쪽으로 떨어지는 구조라면 안쪽에다 떨어뜨려 놓게끔 하거나 ‘세제 놓는 곳’이라고 적혀있는 게 낫지 않나 싶은데 액체형을 쓰시는 분들도 있을테니 어렵네용^^,,,아무튼 큰 팬이나 접시 등을 많이 사용했을 때는 조금 부족하지만 평소 기준으로는 넉넉하다는 점~~그리고 물컵으로 투명 유리컵을 사용중인데 물때없이 깨끗하게 닦인다는 점 아주 만족스럽습니다

Sentence (English): I like it.
Comments (English): I like it. It's a world where even appliances are becoming rockets. I bought it on Coupang because of the rockets. I wanted it to arrive quickly. The technician came the next or two days later and installed it. The LG technician came. The explanation was thorough, and the installation and removal took less than 30 minutes. I bought the one with a hot air dryer. I kept researching, and I was tempted by the saying that there's a difference between having one and not using it and having one and not using it, so I bought the one with a hot air dryer, even though it was 100,000-200,000 won more. After using it for two months, I honestly don't use the hot air dryer. I always turn it on at night and go to bed, so I thought it would just increase my electricity bill, so I barely used it. It might be useful for people who run it during the day to do something urgent like sweeping or washing baby bottles, but the dryer plus takes twice as long, so I don't really use it. If I were to buy it again, I think I'd get the one without a hot air dryer. It's really nice because it has a dishwasher, though. It's nice to save time and be able to spend that time with my family. It's a bit of a hassle to have to do the dishes, put in the spoons, and play Tetris with the bowls, but washing, rinsing, and drying them thoroughly takes longer. And hard-to-reach areas, like cups, especially ceramics and glassware, are incredibly clean. It really depends on the detergent, but even stuck-on dishes can be cleaned quite well with a high-temperature sterilization or down cycle. If you soak the rice cooker before putting it in, it won't come off. The key is to soak it thoroughly. I absolutely hate washing dishes with oil, so I really enjoy doing that. Anyway, I'm very satisfied with the price, delivery time, and product I bought from Coupang. I was very worried about the color, but white (beige) was sold out, so I wanted to get it quickly. I hesitated for a while and ended up going with green. It matches my 46-pyeong (150-square-foot) apartment and dark interior.

Sentence (English): We only purchased this dishwasher about a month ago so the ownership time frame has been relatively short.
Comments (English): [ Great appliance. ] || ---------------- || We only purchased this dishwasher about a month ago so the ownership time frame has been relatively short. We are a family of 5 so we are heavy users of our appliances, and our dishwasher is on daily. This dishwasher was the first built in that we have had and I was reluctant to drill screws into our kitchen. The fitment was relatively simple with a thought out system for leg adjustment front and rear. The dishwasher was significantly lighter than our old free standing unit as it doesn't require in built weight to stop the whole thing from tilting forward when the draw slides out onto the door with the added weight of dishes. The fixed nature of the built in unit(as it is screwed in) holds it in place, this means that the lower draw can slide further out onto the door allowing better access to the top and bottom rack at the same time. The racks have a quality feel to them which sounds odd but try them out in store, they slide a lot easier on what feels like ball bearing slides. The small screen offers more detail than I expected and the simple wash programs are enough for what we need. The pop-open door feature at the end of the wash helps everything to dry off and cool down before emptying. The dishwasher has plenty of space for our needs. Great unit that surprised and I would recommend to any busy family.

Sentence (English): We got our LDPH7972S nearly two months and boy, is it fantastic!
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher Ever Owned, Exceeded Our Expectations!  ] || ---------------- || We got our LDPH7972S nearly two months and boy, is it fantastic! Actually, "game changer" sums it up best. Don't listen to the negative reviews - if you're like us and haven't upgraded your dishwasher in over 10 years, you will be completely awed by how AMAZING this LDPH7972S is in comparison. For starters, it is SO quiet! We never ran our old dishwasher at night, it was so loud. Not this one: we frequently run it on a delay after midnight for time of use savings on our electric bill and we never hear it running! Instead, we're greeted in the morning with sparkling dishes, cups and utensils to be put away. The LDPH7972S does an incredible job of cleaning and drying, especially compared to our old dishwasher. With Finish rinsing agent and quality dish detergent tabs, whatever we wash comes out sparkling clean. We've also found the Night Dry with Dry boost gets everything dry, with the only exception being the bottoms of upside-down coffee mugs or anything else that can collect water if not overturned and/or angled correctly. That's also vast improvement over what we were used to seeing with our old dishwasher. Another feature we like is how easy it is to lower or raise the second and third racks. I could go on about all of the great features of the LDPH7972S, such as the ThinQ app - but suffice it to say that every feature that LG describes on their website about this dishwasher are spot on and work just as described. But there are a couple of incredible features that might go unnoticed in other reviews, so we will mention them here. First, the LDPH7972S is a sleek and beautifully designed dishwasher that instantly upgraded our kitchen and forever transformed our experience with dishwashing. Second are the LED lights, both on the inside of the dishwasher as well as the external LED display that appears near the top center of the door when the machine is powered on. These latter two features are game-changers. Being able to see clearly inside the machine upon opening the door is obviously wonderful, and the exterior LED display is pure, high-tech sorcery. See our uploaded photo of the external LED: I can't stop marveling at how it magically appears without there being any hint of a display screen in the stainless-steel door. Thanks to this LED display, you'll always know the time remaining on the selected wash cycle. It then displays “End” when done, so you'll never have to open your dishwasher to find out if it's really done. We love doing our dishes with the LDPH7972S and you will, too!

You are only able to place maximum of 8 large plates in the bottom rack and the same for bowls. The rest of the rack space cannot be fully utilized for plates or other things that you might want to stay upright without banging into each other when the dishwasher is running. Also, the only way to have dry dishes when the cycle is done, is to run the unit on "sanitize" cycle. Any other cycle leaves a LOT or water remining on the dishes and on the walls of the dishwasher. You MUST hand dry everything if you use any other cycle setting.

The bad news: It is difficult to load. The tines on the bottom rack are close together and tilted so if you want to load anything with higher sides than a dinner plate, you've got a struggle on your hands. Bowls are a problem if you have more than a few that will fit on in the middle of the top rack. The cup rack isn't very useful if the space below it is loaded with small things, because they will block the spray. The knife rack is good for long utensils, but doesn't move, so loading the rack beneath it is awkward. The "extra dry" cycle gets things drier, but plastic still doesn't get completely dry. There is no "clean" indicator so we occasionally load dirty dishes in with the clean ones by mistake. In general, we are disappointed.

Sentence (English): I read a few reviews about this dishwashers drying capabilities in having issues with not having the dishes dry.
Comments (English): [ Pleasantly Surprised ] || ---------------- || I read a few reviews about this dishwashers drying capabilities in having issues with not having the dishes dry. We have had the dishwasher for a few months now and I am not seeing this issue at all. Of course anything that can hold water such as the top of an inverted mug or the rim of pastic containers will have water in them. The energy is would take to evaporate standing water would be rediculous. Using the top rack for cutlery is a game changer. Each piece is kept separate from each other allowing the scouring and cleaning of them. The cutlery has never been so clean, really looking brand new. It also allows you if you take the time while placing the cutlery in to keep all the like items together so, when you are emptying it you are grabbing handfuls of like spoons, forks and knives to put back into the drawer. Not to say that we liked spending the money, but we are kind of glad our old (not really) 7 year old Fridgidair Gallery dishwasher died as this one outperforms it very much.

Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. Recently, my finger pain has been getting worse and swollen, so I've been relying heavily on disposable containers. My daughter offered to buy me one, so I reluctantly accepted it to try it out. I am leaving a review of the inconveniences I experienced, just in case anyone else is unfamiliar with dishwashers like me and feels restless, wondering if there is a defect. My power outlet is a bit far away, so I prepared a multi-outlet power strip. The technician told me this one wouldn't work and advised me to buy a high-output one. I ordered one, but I couldn't wait, so I just tried running it once. It spun vigorously, just like a washing machine. But at one point, it became *so* quiet. When I stepped out, the timer was running, but there was absolutely no sound—it was as if it had paused. I wondered, "What is this?" Was it a defective product? Did it stop because it ran out of power since I wasn't using a high-output power strip? (I actually put my ear to the dishwasher.) In the end, I reset it and ran it again. While doing so, I searched the internet and thoroughly read the manual (which isn't even written in the manual). I decided to try again and wait until the very end this time. When I did, everything paused with 30 minutes remaining, the door opened with 4 minutes left, and after waiting a bit longer, a notification sound rang saying it was done. Sigh. Just one line for novices like me! Just one line. If you had written that it’s not a problem if the operation suddenly stops with 30 minutes left, I wouldn't have been such an idiot as running it over and over again searching online. I just posted this in the hopes that no one else gets confused like I did.

I called at 8AM to make sure they were coming and said yes, I was first because I was the farthest away and would be there 9 -11AM. At 11:30AM I called Home Depot to ask what happened. They said there was a miscommunication and now the would come after 4PM. At 5PM I called again to see what was going on. The driver had called snd not left a messsge and then reported there was a missed attempt. The next Tuesday they came again left a note on door that they were here from 7:59AM to 8:05AM. At 8:06 I opened door to see them driving away. I chased all the way to the road and stood in road and waved my hands. They came and left. I called right away and asked if they could come back and they said NO, I would have to reschedule again. I was so upset, this is rediculous! So now next Saturday. I called and had a local plumber install and charge me $300 more. The next Saturday they came and picked up old washer on front porch and I had him note on paper that they did not install and I would be asking for a credit for the installation. I will NEVER buy anything from Home Depot on line again!

Sentence (English): I am two months into my new dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ A good solid machine, the Flex Rack is worth it! ] || ---------------- || I am two months into my new dishwasher. My KitchenAid (KDTM704KPS) replaced a 25+ year old Viking (Asko). The old machine ran well until replacement parts could no longer be found and the appliance repair guy was too young to have experience with the machine. Times change, time to move on. I debated this along with other top brands (Thermador, Bosch) and ultimately I was in the right place at the right time when a holiday sale came up and I purchased directly through KitchenAid, the deals were better than any local big box stores. After delivery delays of a few weeks, the appliance arrived and was installed and the old one taken away. The installers were great, no problems there. I will miss the old machine quality which is pre-mother board; it had a simple timer dial and no electronics to fail or rust and could have lasted forever if replacement parts were available. The finish is different with the new machine lighter in color, and blueish. The door is thinner and twists and flexes. Overall the style fits well enough with my current appliances all of which are mismatched at this point anyway.The new machine holds more dishes and flatware thanks to the third flex rack, it really makes a difference. We are two people and we now run out of dishes and flatware during the week as a result because it takes longer to fill up the machine with dirty dishes, and we run the machine less often. Placing coffee cups and water glasses in the top rack is impressive. The interior LED light is nice, but not required. The racks are solid and the finish seems sturdy and should last years. I spend more time carefully placing items in the designated spaces, whereas the old machine was more haphazard. In doing so, a lot more dishes can fit, I get the sense that Kitchen Aid designs their machines for everyday life in a thoughtful way. I use a teaspoon of liquid detergent, a tablespoon at most for only the dirtiest of loads, that is all it needs for clean dishes! The top controls do take some getting use to. I accidentally touch them every time I open and close the door and you have to press cancel or else the machine may start up with whatever program was accidentally touched. I have to pay attention especially if the Start button was also pressed. When I do start a cycle, the door counts down and gives me 4 seconds to close and click the door. If not closed in the allotted time, the machine will not run. It's an odd feature that I do not understand why it has to be so quick, I had to get use to it. I will forever miss the old simple dial mechanism. A blue light appears while in use. A white light appears on the door when clean and ready to unload. The beeps are helpful, subtle, not annoying.I tried every setting from the shortest “Express Wash” to the longest options of “Pro Wash with extended dry, and sani rinse”. The more options I selected, the better the cleanliness. I have concluded that as many settings as possible should be activated to get the best wash; Pro Wash, Extended Dry, Sani Rinse; that seems to leave the cleanest dishes with no dishwasher soap smell or taste. The machine will run for almost 4 hours with maxed out settings, and then the Pro dry fan will run almost continuously until the door is opened and the dishes removed. I use the rise setting when the machine is half full because we run the machine less often and the rinse cycle (rinse is like a pre-wash) is needed while the dishes wait for a proper full load and full wash cycle once per week. The noise level can be divided into two categories: water and motor. The water noise is very quiet, hardly noticeable, and sounds like a small child sloshing through a babbling brook at a distance. There is a small vent in the bottom front of the machine that at first I thought was a plastic protector that should be removed but is in fact part of the pro dry system that pumps air through the machine and echoes a faint noise while running. Then there is motor noise, which is more noticeable. When the machine is running, it sounds like a small fish tank motor with more of an electronic buzz. Still overall, the machine is equivalent or slightly quieter than my old machine and I can run it after bedtime without concern of noise.They say Bosch lasts longer due to quality, but I had one in the past and it died after a year and the dishes were left dripping wet so I did not bother fixing it. I fretted over this longevity/quality concern, statistic calculations analysis paralysis and probabilities etc. and ultimately it comes down to luck and a balance of expectations. I expect most new appliance to need some kind of repair over their lifetime regardless of brands because placing electronics and motherboards near water and vibrations is inevitable. I've had to fix refrigerators, washing machines, ice makers etc of all kinds of brands. Even my brand new car needed new electronic modules replaced. It is what it is. I would rather have a machine that is fixable, with commonly and easily available parts as well as knowledgable repair men rather than finding that statistically perfect in every way brand. If it lasts forever, great. And if it breaks, I have a guy for that. Ultimately, I chose a balance between price and quality, and the Kitchen Aid line fits well with that goal and still gives me enough of a high end experience that I'm happy with the performance. It's a good quality machine with a high quality feel, and my dishes are sparkling clean and dry.

I read a few reviews about this dishwashers drying capabilities in having issues with not having the dishes dry. We have had the dishwasher for a few months now and I am not seeing this issue at all. Of course anything that can hold water such as the top of an inverted mug or the rim of pastic containers will have water in them. The energy is would take to evaporate standing water would be rediculous. Using the top rack for cutlery is a game changer. Each piece is kept separate from each other allowing the scouring and cleaning of them. The cutlery has never been so clean, really looking brand new. It also allows you if you take the time while placing the cutlery in to keep all the like items together so, when you are emptying it you are grabbing handfuls of like spoons, forks and knives to put back into the drawer. Not to say that we liked spending the money, but we are kind of glad our old (not really) 7 year old Fridgidair Gallery dishwasher died as this one outperforms it very much.

The insulation is thinner, there's a lot more plastic, the control panel isn't as swish, but where it matters, this is a much better choice. They're probably things that aren't actually dishwasher safe, and probably should be hand washed anyway, but it's good to know if you are looking to buy one of these. Also, the top-shelf knife rack can get stuck under the top sprayer if it gets moved out of place. That was only a problem once, but it was hard to get it free.I would totally buy this dishwasher again.

Sentence (English): Overall, I am very impressed with the quality and function of the machine.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher with a few flaws ] || ---------------- || Overall, I am very impressed with the quality and function of the machine. Its ability to clean and dry dishes is well beyond any other dishwasher I have owned. The ability to manipulate the racks is great. This option allows dishes of any shape or size to fit. The brushed finish goes great with any color or kitchen decor. Installation was easy and to the point. Anyone with basic handyman knowledge should have no issues with installing the unit. The wash cycles are a bit too long with no ability for a quick wash. The app can be a bit finicky. Sometimes it connects to my phone while other times it connects seamlessly. I did have to unplug the unit and reconnect it to reset the WiFi. This helped the connection issues. Only time will tell if it continues to be a problem. Overall, I am happy with the dishwasher and if necessary in the future will only buy Bosch. This is an item that you get what you pay for. Don't hesitate purchasing this.

This reduces the efficiency of the lower rack for large pots and pans. The entire inside of the machine seems poorly designed for a $1500.00 appliance. Would not recommend anyone to purchase this mode.

Sentence (English): Finally I found a dishwasher I'm happy with.
Comments (English): [ A VERY Good Choice For Us ] || ---------------- || Finally I found a dishwasher I'm happy with. This is my FOURTH dishwasher I've had since I bought my house 9 years ago! So many reviews discuss the quietness of the appliance. I dont care if it sounded like a jackhammer, I wanted one that cleaned well. My 2 most recent models were Maytag. Mid-priced models. No matter what, after a short period of time, the dishes and glasses came out dirty, needing to be washed by hand. I cleaned the (difficult to access) filter. I used the Cascaid Ultra Premium Gold. 2 of them . & turbo blast setting! Nothing helped. I know it's the same company (Maytag which used to have the reputation for solid appliance is owned by Kitchenaid). I was really hesitant but I bought this model. I am so happy with the way it cleans. I don't pre rinse things. Scrape off food then load it in the dishwasher! I've yet had to rewash a single glass, frypan, etc using the Normal setting and one Finish tablet. Hopefully it stays this way but from my heavy use over the past couple weeks, I'd highly recommend this dishwasher. Oh, it's also really quiet. Shout out to the 27 Farms, contracted installers. Timely, friendly, & professional. Worked w me through a last minute schedule change, which was so helpful.

Sentence (English): I just bought this dishwasher after having a previous model, the SGV67T33EU, which lasted me 17 years and was, without a doubt, a great purchase.
Comments (English): [ Good purchase, reliable brand but some doubts ] || ---------------- || I just bought this dishwasher after having a previous model, the SGV67T33EU, which lasted me 17 years and was, without a doubt, a great purchase. Although I have just started using this model, I trust that it will give me a good result, since the brand seems reliable to me. My washing machine is also Bosch, it is 18 years old and it still works there. I hope they do not disappoint me with the planned obsolescence of the new models and they are as reliable as the ones I bought at the time. I miss an interior light and I'm not sure that the cutlery tray is better for cleaning than the baskets, although it does give you more space in the trolley below. The overall feel is good, but the one I just retired had steel and metal details that seem higher quality than some of the plastic finishes on the new model (for example, the top panel on the front of the door , the closing mechanism of the appliance or the filtration grille that surrounds the drain, which was previously made entirely of stainless steel and completely removable and is now divided into two parts, one of them made of plastic and screwed). We'll see what happens with use. I also find it interesting that the water saving compared to a 2007 class A is approximately 3 liters per eco cycle and the electricity saving is 30-40%. I hope to notice it on the bill as I use it daily, sometimes even twice a day.
Comments (Original): [ Buena compra, marca fiable pero algunas dudas ] || ---------------- || Acabo de comprar este lavavajillas después de tener un modelo anterior, el SGV67T33EU, que me ha durado 17 años y fue, sin lugar a dudas, una gran compra. Aunque este modelo acabo de empezar a usarlo, confío en que me de un buen resultado, ya que la marca me parece fiable. Mi lavadora también es Bosch, tiene ya 18 años y ahí sigue funcionando. Espero que no me decepcionen con la obsolescencia programada de los nuevos modelos y sean tan fiables como los que compré en su día. Echo de menos una luz interior y no tengo claro que la bandeja de cubiertos sea mejor en limpieza que las cestas, aunque hace que tengas más espacio en el carro de abajo. La sensación, en general, es buena, pero el que acabo de jubilar tenía detalles de acero y metal que parecen de calidad superior a algunos acabados en plástico que tiene el modelo nuevo (por ejemplo, el panel superior de la parte frontal de la puerta, el mecanismo de cierre del aparato o la rejilla de filtración que rodea al desagüe, que antes era íntegramente de acero inoxidable y completamente extraíble y ahora está dividida en dos partes, una de ellas de plástico y atornillada). Veremos qué ocurre con el uso. También me parece interesante que el ahorro de agua respecto a un clase A de 2007 es de aproximadamente 3 litros por ciclo eco y el ahorro de luz es de un 30-40%. Espero notarlo en la factura, ya que lo uso a diario, en ocasiones incluso dos veces al día.

Sentence (English): I moved in and kept using the built-in dishwasher that was over 10 years old.
Comments (English): I moved in and kept using the built-in dishwasher that was over 10 years old. When I moved, I deliberately chose the color of the sink to match the color of the LG dishwasher, but I couldn't buy it because the 14-person dishwasher I wanted to buy had a low mop holder. But! Finally, a new 14-person dishwasher came out~ And it has a 15cm mop holder that fits my house perfectly. . I paid for it and had it installed as soon as I saw it. The color is perfect and it fits my house sink. I'm so satisfied. I've only used the 6-person LG dishwasher before, but I'm very satisfied with the results so far. Now I'm free from the stress of dishwasher Tetris~^^
